decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established dumper business, it likely shares engineering, sales and service resources, so with little negative evidence after only one year the option is worth keeping open.

This articulated construction dumper fits the core product and customer base, and in a growing industry a mature German machinery maker would usually allow more time before abandoning such an adjacent launch.

Because this underground mine rescue vehicle is farther from the core range and likely serves a narrower, more uncertain market, its withdrawal risk is clearly higher, but after just one year the firm would still tend to preserve the option unless results were clearly poor.

A telescopic loader line with several models signals broader commitment and reuse of existing capabilities, making it relatively cheap to continue compared with the option value of learning and building presence in the segment.
